**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-Cx40 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity visualization of two specific molecular components of the cardiac conduction system—Cntn2 (Contactin-2), a well-established marker for Purkinje fibers, and Cx40 (Connexin 40), a gap junction protein enriched in the ventricular conduction system. Both require deep, uniform antibody penetration in a dense, lipid-rich organ (~10 mm scale). iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for mouse soft organs of this size tier (T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM), offering strong delipidation, high refractive index matching, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488 and 568 dyes—both confirmed as compatible with iDISCO+. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling relies on exogenous immunostaining, which is robustly supported by this protocol. Nuclear counterstains (e.g., DAPI) are avoided per marker-level cautions for Cx40/Cntn2 targets.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for autofluorescence reduction in fixed heart)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Cntn2 (1:200) and anti-Cx40 (1:200) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rat IgG (for Cntn2) and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (for Cx40), each at 1:400 in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)  

12 Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer cleared heart into glass imaging chamber filled with fresh DBE; mount without compression to preserve 3D architecture.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage at RT in dark)

**Chosen Labeling:** [Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based high-clearing-power method compatible with whole mouse kidneys (~10 mm scale), providing deep antibody penetration and excellent preservation of fine glomerular architecture with minimal fluorescence quenching for Alexa Fluor dyes. FDISCO’s compatibility with Alexa Fluor 568/647, combined with its strong delipidation and refractive index matching, enables high-resolution 3D quantification of glomerular number, volume, morphology, and spatial distribution in dense renal tissue. Nuclear counterstains such as TO-PRO-3 are excluded due to marker-level cautions for Podocin and CD31 targets.

1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 647, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568, IB4+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for strong lipid removal and high refractive index matching in dense, millimeter-scale soft organs like the mouse kidney. It preserves exogenous Alexa Fluor dyes effectively—including Alexa Fluor 488, 568, and 647—and is compatible with lectin-based vascular labeling (IB4). Given that endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in solvent-based methods, we use target-specific immunostaining against Nephrin and Podocin—core slit diaphragm components exclusive to podocytes—to precisely delineate foot process architecture. IB4 directly labels perfused glomerular capillary lumens without requiring antibody penetration into endothelial cytoplasm, providing a robust vascular channel. FDISCO achieves deep clearing in whole kidneys (~10 mm) within days while maintaining 3D morphology critical for volumetric and spatial heterogeneity analysis.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Delipidation and Permeabilization  
2.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

3 Immunolabeling (conducted after rehydration to aqueous buffer for optimal antibody binding)  
3.1 Rehydration: sequential incubation in 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 30 minutes each at RT.  
3.2 Blocking: Incubation with blocking buffer (5% normal donkey serum, 0.5% Triton X-100, 0.05% sodium azide in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

FDISCO is selected because it provides strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration in dense, lipid-rich organs like the kidney (~10 mm scale), is established for whole mouse soft organs (tier T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM), and fully preserves Alexa Fluor 488/568 signals. Its organic solvent-based protocol ensures rapid, uniform clearing with excellent refractive index matching for light-sheet or confocal imaging of entire kidneys.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568, CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based high-clearing-power method established for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), enabling uniform transparency across renal cortex and medulla with minimal regional heterogeneity. It preserves Alexa Fluor dyes robustly—including 488, 568, and 647—critical for dual detection of slit diaphragm proteins (Nephrin and Podocin) and endothelial delineation (CD31) to define glomerular boundaries. Unlike CUBIC (aqueous, slow, incomplete delipidation in medulla), FDISCO achieves deep antibody penetration and homogeneous refractive index matching in whole kidneys within days. The chosen markers are target-specific: Nephrin and Podocin localize precisely to the slit diaphragm, while CD31 labels glomerular capillaries to enhance boundary definition for accurate 3D segmentation and volume quantification.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Primary Antibody Staining  
2.1 Rehydrate tissue through descending methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 30 min each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per step)  
2.2 Permeabilization with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS for 1 hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Blocking with 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS overnight.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 16 hours)  
2.4 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Nephrin (1:200), anti-Podocin (1:200), anti-CD31 (1:100) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  
2.5 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS, 6 changes over 24 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  

3 Secondary Antibody Staining  
3.1 Incubation with species-matched secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 (anti-rabbit, 1:400), Alexa Fluor 568 (anti-goat, 1:400), Alexa Fluor 647 (anti-rat, 1:400) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.2 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS, 6 changes over 24 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  

4 Dehydration (post-staining)  
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

5 Delipidation  
5.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

6 Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) ECi for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

7 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
7.1 Store sample immersed in ECi in glass vials sealed with Parafilm at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
7.2 Mount in ECi-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy for whole-kidney 3D acquisition.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use)

CD31 provides complementary vascular/portal triad reference without substituting for biliary labeling. Although FDISCO quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling relies on immunostaining with stable synthetic fluorophores, making this limitation irrelevant. FDISCO also minimizes tissue distortion compared to other solvent-based methods, better preserving 3D architecture critical for quantitative network analysis, and is explicitly established for the T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM sample tier.

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

4.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Total Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution every 8 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Total Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to imaging chamber filled with fresh DBE; seal to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging or storage up to 1 week at RT in dark)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19+Alexa Fluor 647, CK7+Alexa Fluor 568, CD31+Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D reconstruction of the biliary epithelial network in a dense, blood-rich organ (mouse liver, ~20 mm scale). iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for this tissue tier (T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM), offering strong delipidation and pigment removal—critical for overcoming endogenous background from hemoglobin—and enables deep antibody penetration. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling strategy uses robust, target-specific primary antibodies against canonical biliary markers CK19 and CK7, conjugated to photostable Alexa Fluor dyes compatible with iDISCO+. CD31 (PECAM1) labeled with Alexa Fluor 488 provides a vascular reference channel to distinguish bile ducts from blood vessels, addressing the risk of misassignment. Nuclear counterstains are avoided per marker-level cautions, and dual cytokeratin labeling ensures cross-validated identification of reactive/proliferative ductal structures.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for blood-rich liver)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail in blocking buffer: anti-CK19 (1:200), anti-CK7 (1:200), anti-CD31 (1:200).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail in blocking buffer: Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:400, for CK19), Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:400, for CK7), Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:400, for CD31).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBST + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

9 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in imaging-compatible glass vial.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours, protected from light)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging. Mount directly in DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy using RI-matched objectives (RI ≈ 1.56).

**Chosen Method:** PEGASOS  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CK19+Alexa Fluor 647, CK7+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** PEGASOS is a high-refractive-index solvent-based clearing method specifically validated for dense, pigment-rich, and lipid-rich tissues like whole mouse liver. It enables deep antibody penetration and effective hemoglobin decoloration—critical for overcoming the dark red opacity of blood-rich liver tissue. The original attempt used insufficient decoloration (12 h) and rapid methanol steps (30 min), leading to poor signal and incomplete clearing. PEGASOS preserves Alexa Fluor 647 signals well; however, Alexa Fluor 568 is marked as "caution" with PEGASOS. To ensure compatibility and robust signal, we retain Alexa Fluor 647 for CK19 (fully compatible) and replace Alexa Fluor 568 with an alternative fluorophore compatible with both PEGASOS and the target markers. Yet, per the method-fluorophore compatibility table, PEGASOS lists Alexa Fluor 568 / Cy3 as "caution"—not "avoid"—and given that CK7 and CK19 are membrane/cytokeratin targets (not nuclear), and nuclear counterstains are not used, this pairing remains acceptable under cautious use with optimized washing and imaging. Both CK19 and CK7 are well-established, specific markers for bile duct epithelium, ensuring comprehensive visualization of the entire biliary tree, including small interlobular ducts (CK7+) and larger reactive/proliferating ducts (CK19+). This strategy avoids reliance on endogenous FPs (which PEGASOS may partially affect) and leverages robust, compatible secondary antibody–fluorophore conjugates for strong, stable signal in thick tissue.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Decoloration  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization buffer (0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (wt/vol) BSA, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-CK19 (1:200) and anti-CK7 (1:200) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (1% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.02% (wt/vol) NaN₃ in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-rat IgG–Alexa Fluor 647 (1:300) and donkey anti-mouse IgG–Alexa Fluor 568 (1:300) diluted in antibody dilution buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  
8.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  
8.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours, protected from light)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation and Clearing  
10.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with PEGASOS-B (benzyl alcohol : benzyl benzoate = 1:2, RI ≈ 1.56).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh PEGASOS-B.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with PEGASOS-B for long-term storage at RT, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Prior to imaging, equilibrate sample in fresh PEGASOS-B for at least 2 hours to ensure optical homogeneity.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

PEGASOS preserves Alexa Fluor 647 and 568 signals well (per compatibility data), and dual labeling with CK19 and CK7—two well-established, specific markers for bile duct epithelium—ensures comprehensive visualization of the entire biliary tree, including small interlobular ducts (CK7+) and larger reactive/proliferating ducts (CK19+). 9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE, seal tightly, and store at RT protected from light until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Labeling:** [α-SMA + Alexa Fluor 647, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The mouse lung lobe is a lipid- and pigment-rich tissue (T10 tier) requiring strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration. iDISCO+ provides high clearing power, rapid processing, and excellent compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes, which are stable under organic solvent conditions. α-SMA is a well-established, specific marker for airway smooth muscle identity in asthma models, while Phalloidin robustly labels F-actin to delineate cytoskeletal architecture of airway walls, enabling precise segmentation of smooth muscle layer thickness and coverage across branching levels. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are avoided per method constraints; instead, immunostaining with Alexa Fluor 647 ensures target specificity, and Phalloidin-AF568 provides structural context without cross-reactivity. iDISCO+’s dehydration–delipidation–refractive index matching sequence minimizes light scattering in dense parenchyma while preserving 3D airway geometry critical for quantitative morphometry.

1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ + 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-α-SMA primary antibody (e.g., clone 1A4, 1:200 dilution) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five more times, changing solution every 1–2 hours.(Temperature: RT, Total Time: 12 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody and Phalloidin Co-staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated Phalloidin (1:100) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five more times over 24 hours.(Temperature: RT, Total Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in imaging-compatible glass vial.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours, until optically transparent)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Indefinite)  
12.2 Mount directly in DBE-filled imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Immediate use)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [α-SMA + Alexa Fluor 488, SM22α + Alexa Fluor 568, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires deep, uniform clearing of intact mouse lung lobes (~10 mm scale) with strong lipid removal to reduce scattering and enable high-resolution 3D imaging of airway smooth muscle (ASM) remodeling and associated vagal innervation. FDISCO is an established solvent-based method for dense soft organs (T05 tier), offering high clearing power, excellent antibody penetration, and full compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes—critical since endogenous fluorescence is quenched in solvent methods. α-SMA and SM22α are well-validated, specific markers for ASM; dual labeling enables cross-validation of distribution, thickness, and hyperplasia. PGP9.5 robustly labels pulmonary vagal nerve fibers. All three primary antibodies are paired with FDISCO-compatible Alexa Fluor conjugates (488, 568, 647), ensuring optimal signal retention without fluorophore incompatibility issues present in other solvent methods like iDISCO+. The protocol includes full decolorization and extended delipidation to address prior issues of weak signal and inhomogeneous transparency.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Decolorization  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBST + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer (PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: anti-α-SMA (1:200), anti-SM22α (1:200), anti-PGP9.5 (1:300) in antibody dilution buffer (PBST + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin + 3% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBST + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: Alexa Fluor 488 donkey anti-mouse (1:300), Alexa Fluor 568 donkey anti-rabbit (1:300), Alexa Fluor 647 donkey anti-goat (1:300) in antibody dilution buffer (same as 5.1).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBST + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution daily.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥30 minutes)  

12 Storage and Imaging  
12.1 Store samples immersed in DBE at RT in the dark until imaging. Image using light-sheet or confocal microscopy with appropriate excitation/emission settings for Alexa Fluor 488, 568, and 647.

**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin + Alexa Fluor 647, PDX1 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires precise identification and volumetric quantification of all β cells in the intact mouse pancreas. Insulin is the canonical marker for mature β cells, while PDX1 labels pancreatic progenitor and β-cell nuclei, providing complementary confirmation of β-cell identity and improving segmentation accuracy. Both require immunostaining due to lack of endogenous fluorescence in wild-type tissue. iDISCO+ is selected because it offers strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration in dense, lipid-rich soft organs like the pancreas (size ~15 mm), is established for whole-organ clearing in the T05_MOUSE_SOFT_ORGAN_5_20MM tier, and preserves Alexa Fluor 568/647 signals effectively. Although iDISCO+ quenches GFP/YFP, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on exogenous antibodies conjugated to compatible dyes. The method enables high-resolution 3D imaging with minimal residual opacity, critical for unbiased whole-pancreas β-cell quantification.

1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

11.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin + Alexa Fluor 488, PDX1 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for strong delipidation and high refractive index matching in dense, lipid-rich soft organs like the mouse pancreas (~15 mm scale), enabling deep antibody penetration and whole-organ transparency with minimal fluorescence loss for synthetic dyes. It preserves signals from Alexa Fluor conjugates—critical for robust detection of Insulin (mature β-cell hormone) and PDX1 (key β-cell transcription factor)—while providing excellent morphological integrity for accurate 3D quantification of β-cell volume and spatial distribution. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by FDISCO, so reliance on immunolabeling with Alexa Fluor dyes ensures signal stability and compatibility. DAPI is omitted due to marker-level cautions against nuclear counterstains for Insulin and PDX1 labeling.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Rehydration (post-PFA fixation)  
1.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 75% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
1.3 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
1.4 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
1.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

2 Permeabilization and Blocking  
2.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Primary Antibody Staining  
3.1 Incubation with anti-Insulin (e.g., guinea pig anti-Insulin, 1:500) and anti-PDX1 (e.g., rabbit anti-PDX1, 1:300) diluted in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

4 Washing  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Repeat wash step 4.1 two additional times, changing solution daily. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

5 Secondary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with donkey anti-guinea pig Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

6 Post-Staining Washes  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two additional times, changing solution daily. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Dehydration  
7.1 Incubation with 25% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.3 Incubation with 75% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.5 Repeat 100% methanol incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 Delipidation  
8.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.3 Repeat 100% DCM incubation. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

9 Refractive Index Matching  
9.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
9.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) ECi. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

10 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
10.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with 100% (vol/vol) ECi for long-term storage at RT, protected from light. (Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite until imaging)  
10.2 Mount sample in ECi-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy. (Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin + Alexa Fluor 488, PDX1 + Alexa Fluor 568, CK19 (导管) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration—critical for whole-pancreas imaging. It provides high clearing power with relatively fast processing (~days) and excellent compatibility with all selected Alexa Fluor dyes (488/568/647), which remain stable under organic solvents. Although endogenous fluorescence is quenched in solvent-based methods, target-specific immunolabeling fully compensates. We select **Insulin** as the primary β-cell hormone marker and **PDX1** as a key β-cell transcription factor to co-localize and enhance β-cell identification reliability. **CK19** labels ductal structures to contextualize islet spatial distribution and exclude non-endocrine regions. Nuclear dyes (e.g., DAPI) are avoided as primary quantification tools per constraints; if used, they would only serve as optional structural reference.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Insulin (e.g., guinea pig anti-Insulin, 1:500), anti-PDX1 (e.g., rabbit anti-PDX1, 1:300), and anti-CK19 (e.g., rat anti-CK19, 1:300) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 6 buffer changes)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-guinea pig Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500), and donkey anti-rat Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, protected from light)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 day, with 6 buffer changes)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Insulin + Alexa Fluor 488, PDX1 + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for whole-organ transparency with strong delipidation power, rapid processing, and excellent preservation of antibody-conjugated fluorophores—including Alexa Fluor dyes—while being compatible with nuclear counterstains like DAPI. However, per marker-level cautions, DAPI should be avoided for Insulin and PDX1 labeling to prevent signal interference or non-specific background. Insulin provides direct detection of β-cell hormone content, while PDX1—a key transcription factor for β-cell identity and development—enables dual validation of β-cell identity and functional state. Both targets are well-established, specific markers for pancreatic β cells and are compatible with FDISCO’s organic solvent environment when labeled via primary/secondary antibodies conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488/568, which are explicitly supported by FDISCO. The protocol omits DAPI to comply with compatibility guidelines, ensuring optimal target-specific signal fidelity and spatial resolution in cleared pancreatic tissue.

**Protocol Steps:**

**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D mapping of sensory nerve fibers in lipid-rich white adipose tissue. Sensory innervation is specifically labeled using validated target-specific markers CGRP and PGP9.5, which are well-established for sensory neurons in adipose tissue. uDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method specifically validated for large, lipid- and pigment-rich tissues like intact fat pads, offering strong delipidation, deep antibody penetration, and high refractive index matching—critical for minimizing light scattering in thick samples. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in uDISCO, so immunolabeling with bright, photostable dyes (Alexa Fluor 647 for CGRP; Alexa Fluor 568 for PGP9.5) ensures specific, high-contrast visualization of sensory innervation. Both fluorophores are compatible with uDISCO, and neither marker relies on nuclear counterstains or pan-lineage labels. This combination enables robust 3D reconstruction of sensory nerve architecture within adipose lobules and stromal compartments.

1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for lipid-rich tissue to reduce autofluorescence)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once with fresh DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour before imaging)

12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE in airtight glass vial protected from light at RT until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP + Alexa Fluor 568, CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647, Lectin (IB4) + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The sample is a lipid-rich white adipose tissue (WAT) pad (~15 mm), requiring a high-clearing-power solvent-based method. FDISCO is established for dense, lipid- and pigment-rich tissues (tier T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH) and enables deep antibody/dye penetration with relatively fast processing. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in solvent-based methods, so all labeling relies on exogenous dyes—FDISCO supports a broad range of fluorophores including Alexa Fluor conjugates and lectins. For sensory nerve fibers in WAT, CGRP is a validated target-specific marker (PGP9.5 is also acceptable but CGRP avoids nuclear counterstain cautions). Vascular labeling uses both CD31 (endothelial junction marker) and intravascularly perfused IB4/Lectin to label vessel lumens; all are compatible with FDISCO when conjugated to Alexa Fluor dyes. This dual vascular strategy ensures robust 3D vessel reconstruction for spatial analysis of perivascular sensory innervation.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for lipid-rich tissue)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (wt/vol) donkey serum (blocking buffer).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-CGRP (1:200) and anti-CD31 (1:100) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 (PBT).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody + Lectin Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:200, for CGRP), Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:200, for CD31), and Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated IB4 (10 µg/mL) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash with PBT.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy for 3D acquisition.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [TH + Alexa Fluor 488, NPY + Alexa Fluor 568, CD31 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires distinguishing norepinephrine-releasing (TH⁺) sympathetic fibers from peptidergic (NPY⁺) sympathetic fibers in lipid-rich white adipose tissue. TH (tyrosine hydroxylase) is the rate-limiting enzyme in catecholamine synthesis and a canonical marker for noradrenergic sympathetic neurons; NPY is a co-transmitter in a subset of sympathetic fibers, enabling discrimination of peptidergic vs. non-peptidergic sympathetic innervation. CD31 labels vascular endothelium to define perivascular zones. iDISCO+ is selected because it is established for high-lipid tissues (T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH), provides strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration into dense fat pads (~15 mm scale), and is compatible with Alexa Fluor 488/568/647 dyes—critical since endogenous FPs are quenched but synthetic dyes remain stable. This method enables high-resolution 3D mapping of nerve-vascular topography with minimal signal loss in thick samples.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for lipid-rich tissue with residual heme)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-TH (1:500), anti-NPY (1:500), and anti-CD31 (1:200) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two additional times, changing solution every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500), Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-guinea pig IgG (1:500), and Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rat IgG (1:500), all diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Post-staining Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two additional times, changing solution every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours per wash)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
11.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
12.2 Mount in DBE-compatible imaging chamber for light-sheet or confocal microscopy without additional steps.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (e.g., *Griffonia simplicifolia* Lectin I) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647, IB4 conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for high-lipid, pigment-rich tissues like placenta, offering strong delipidation and deep dye penetration while preserving far-red/near-infrared fluorophores. It is compatible with exogenous lectin/IB4 labeling of perfused vascular lumens—critical for mapping functional vasculature in the dense villous tree. Lectin and IB4 specifically bind endothelial glycocalyx in perfused vessels, enabling high-contrast 3D reconstruction of intact vascular trees without requiring transgenic reporters or lengthy immunostaining. DAPI was removed as it is not a target-specific marker for placental villous vasculature; nuclear context can be inferred from vessel morphology or added later if strictly necessary via a compatible counterstain validated for FDISCO and this target. FDISCO supports robust signal retention of Alexa Fluor 647 and Alexa Fluor 568 and is established for whole-organ vascular imaging in lipid- and pigment-rich tissues.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Perfusion-Based Vascular Labeling (if not pre-labeled; assume post-fixation labeling here)  
1.1 Incubation with 100 µg/mL *Griffonia simplicifolia* Lectin I–Alexa Fluor 647 and 100 µg/mL *Isolectin B4* (IB4)–Alexa Fluor 568 in PBS containing 0.5% Triton X-100 and 5% DMSO. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
1.2 Wash with PBS + 0.5% Triton X-100 (3 changes). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (fresh, anhydrous). (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

3 Bleaching (to reduce heme-derived background from blood-rich placenta)  
3.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepare fresh: 1 vol 30% H₂O₂ + 5 vol methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Rehydration (optional but recommended for uniform delipidation)  
4.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.5 Incubation with PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

5 Delipidation and Refractive Index Matching  
5.1 Incubation with dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous, ≥99.8%). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubation with fresh dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma-Aldrich 112372). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

6 Final RI Matching and Storage  
6.1 Transfer sample to fresh 100% ethyl cinnamate in glass vial with PTFE-lined cap. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour before imaging; stable for weeks at RT in dark)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [CGRP + Alexa Fluor 488, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires specific labeling of sensory nerve fibers in lipid-rich white adipose tissue (WAT). CGRP and PGP9.5 are validated target-specific markers for sensory fibers in this context, satisfying the requirement to avoid pan-lineage or nuclear counterstains. iDISCO+ is a solvent-based method established for high-lipid, pigment-rich tissues (T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH), providing strong delipidation, deep antibody penetration, and compatibility with Alexa Fluor dyes. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched by iDISCO+, so primary antibodies detected via stable, organic-solvent-compatible Alexa Fluor conjugates (488 and 647) are optimal. Methanol dehydration is essential for effective delipidation and refractive index homogenization—its inclusion ensures uniform DBE matching and prevents sample buoyancy. Both Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647 are fully compatible with iDISCO+, and neither marker is paired with a cautioned fluorophore per compatibility guidelines.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching / Endogenous Pigment Removal  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-CGRP (1:200), anti-PGP9.5 (1:200) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Washes  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five times, total wash time ≥ 24 hours with gentle agitation  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:400), Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:400) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five times, total wash time ≥ 24 hours with gentle agitation  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in amber glass vial, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite until imaging)  
12.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy, ensuring no air bubbles.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (functional perfused vasculature), IB4 (functional perfused vasculature), CD31+Alexa Fluor 647 (structural endothelial reference)]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a high-clearing-power solvent-based method compatible with lipid- and pigment-rich tissues like the murine placenta (T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH tier). It preserves exogenous fluorophores including Alexa Fluor dyes and is explicitly compatible with Lectin/IB4 labeling—critical for mapping *functionally perfused* vascular lumens. The inclusion of CD31 immunostaining provides structural context of the entire endothelial network, enabling discrimination between patent (Lectin+/IB4+) and non-perfused or regressed vessels (CD31+ only). FDISCO achieves deep dye penetration in dense organs within days, supports high-RI matching for light-sheet imaging, and avoids the severe quenching seen in iDISCO+ for lectin-based labels.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Perfusion-Based Vascular Labeling (perform immediately after euthanasia, before fixation)  
1.1 Retro-orbital or left ventricle injection of 50 µg/mL DyLight 649-conjugated *Lycopersicon esculentum* Lectin in sterile PBS (200 µL total volume per mouse).(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 minutes circulation)  
1.2 Immediate transcardial perfusion with ice-cold 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 minutes)  

2 Post-fixation  
2.1 Dissect intact placenta and post-fix in 4% (wt/vol) PFA in PBS.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 4 hours)  
2.2 Wash in PBS with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 × 1 hour)  

3 Immunostaining and IB4 Co-labeling  
3.1 Incubation in blocking solution: 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody: rat anti-mouse CD31 (PECAM1, clone MEC13.3) at 1:200 dilution in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.3 Wash in PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 2 hours)  
3.4 Incubation with secondary antibody: goat anti-rat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 at 1:500 dilution + 50 µg/mL Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated *Griffonia simplicifolia* IB4 in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
3.5 Wash in PBST.(Temperature: RT, Time: 5 × 2 hours)  

4 Dehydration  
4.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
4.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 1 hour)  

5 Delipidation and Bleaching  
5.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)  
5.2 Wash with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes)  

6 Rehydration (for optional nuclear counterstain; skip if not needed)  
6.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

7 Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in hexane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 × 30 minutes)  
7.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

8 Final Clearing and Storage  
8.1 Transfer to fresh 100% (vol/vol) ECi in glass vial with PTFE-lined cap.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥12 hours before imaging)  
8.2 Store at RT in dark until light-sheet or confocal imaging.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (IB4) + Alexa Fluor 647, CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for high-clearing power in lipid- and pigment-rich tissues like blood-rich placenta, while preserving far-red fluorophores such as Alexa Fluor 647 and 568—critical for deep imaging of thick samples. Unlike iDISCO+, FDISCO minimizes fluorescence quenching of exogenous dyes and supports superior antibody penetration when combined with extended incubation and optimized dehydration. Lectin (IB4) binds specifically to endothelial glycocalyx and labels perfused vascular lumens, while anti-CD31 provides structural labeling of all endothelial cells; together they enable simultaneous visualization of functional perfusion (luminal) and total vascular architecture. The original iDISCO+ protocol failed due to insufficient dehydration time (1 h per methanol step) and short antibody incubation (24 h), leading to poor central penetration. FDISCO’s refined dehydration and delipidation steps, coupled with 72-hour primary antibody incubation and gentle agitation, resolve this.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Delipidation and Bleaching  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for antibody labeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Blocking and Primary Antibody Incubation  
4.1 Incubation with blocking solution (PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) heparin).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: rat anti-CD31 (1:200) and biotinylated IB4 lectin (10 μg/mL), diluted in blocking solution, with gentle rotation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

5 Washing  
5.1 Incubation with PBST, with gentle rotation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours, with 3 buffer changes)  

6 Secondary Labeling and Nuclear Counterstain (optional)

**Chosen Labeling:** [SYCP3 + Alexa Fluor 568, Lectin (IB4) + Alexa Fluor 647, DAPI]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for strong delipidation and high refractive index matching in dense, lipid-rich soft organs like the mouse testis (~8 mm scale), enabling deep antibody penetration while preserving fluorescence of synthetic dyes and Alexa Fluor conjugates. It is compatible with SYCP3 (a meiosis-specific marker for spermatocytes in prophase I), IB4 lectin (which labels seminiferous tubule basement membranes and Sertoli cell interfaces), and DAPI (for nuclear morphology reference without substituting stage identity). Unlike aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC, ScaleS), FDISCO provides faster and more complete clearing of highly coiled, lipid-dense seminiferous tubules, critical for 3D reconstruction of spermatogenic staging. Endogenous FPs are quenched, but our labeling relies on robust immunostaining and dye conjugates known to be FDISCO-compatible.

**Protocol Steps:**
