**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (Alexa Fluor 647), IB4 (Alexa Fluor 568), CD31 (PECAM1) + Alexa Fluor 488, DAPI]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a high-clearing-power solvent-based method optimized for lipid- and pigment-rich tissues like placenta, offering excellent penetration, strong delipidation, and effective heme removal while preserving exogenous fluorophore signals—including Alexa Fluor dyes and lectin conjugates. It is compatible with all selected labels (Lectin, IB4, CD31-AF488, DAPI), enabling simultaneous visualization of functional perfused vasculature (via Lectin/IB4 binding to endothelial glycocalyx), structural endothelial integrity (CD31), and nuclear counterstaining. FDISCO minimizes fluorescence quenching compared to iDISCO+/uDISCO and achieves whole-organ transparency in dense, blood-rich samples within days—critical for resolving the intricate 3D architecture of the murine placental villous tree at full organ scale.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Permeabilization and Hemoglobin Quenching  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

2 Rehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

3 Blocking and Primary Antibody Staining (for CD31)  
3.1 Incubation with blocking solution: 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with primary antibody: rat anti-mouse CD31 (PECAM1, 1:200 dilution) in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
3.3 Wash with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 changes)  

4 Secondary Antibody and Lectin/IB4 Co-staining  
4.1 Incubation with secondary antibody: goat anti-rat IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500), plus biotinylated *Griffonia simplicifolia* Lectin I (1:200) and *Isolectin B4* from *Bandeiraea simplicifolia* (IB4, 1:200), all in blocking solution.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
4.2 Wash with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 changes)  
4.3 Incubation with streptavidin-conjugated Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) to amplify Lectin signal, if needed.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.4 Final wash with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 3 changes)  

5 Dehydration  
5.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.4 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour × 2 changes)  

6 Delipidation and Refractive Index Matching  
6.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes × 2 changes)  
6.3 Incubation with 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma E1500).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
6.4 Incubation with fresh 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

7 Nuclear Counterstaining (DAPI) – optional post-clearing if not done earlier  
7.1 Rehydrate through reverse methanol series: 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% methanol in PBS (30 min each, RT), then PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per step)  
7.2 Incubation with DAPI (1 µg/mL in PBS).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
7.3 Re-dehydrate through methanol series to 100% MeOH, then proceed to DCM and ECi as in Steps 5–6.(Temperature: RT, Time: as above)  

8 Final Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Store cleared placenta in 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi) in light-protected glass vial.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
8.2 Mount sample in ECi-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy (RI ≈ 1.558).

8.1 Store cleared placenta in 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi) in light-protected glass vial.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (e.g., *Lycopersicon esculentum* lectin or *Griffonia simplicifolia* IB4) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 for functional perfused vasculature; anti-CD31 (PECAM1) primary antibody + Alexa Fluor 488 secondary antibody for endothelial structural morphology]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based, high-clearing-power method established for lipid- and pigment-rich tissues like placenta (T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH tier). It preserves exogenous fluorophores (including Alexa Fluor dyes and lectins) while enabling deep penetration into dense, intact organs (~12 mm diameter). Lectin perfusion labels only patent, functionally perfused vascular lumens at the time of fixation, directly addressing “functional灌流” status. CD31 immunostaining reveals all endothelial-lined vessels regardless of perfusion, enabling direct spatial comparison between structural and functional vascular networks in labyrinth, maternal-fetal interface, and periphery. FDISCO’s compatibility with both Alexa Fluor 488 and 647 ensures robust dual-channel signal retention through dehydration and clearing.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Perfusion-Based Functional Vascular Labeling (Perform immediately after euthanasia, before fixation)  
1.1 Intracardiac perfusion with 10 mL ice-cold PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: ~2 min) followed by 5 mL of 50 µg/mL *Lycopersicon esculentum* lectin (or *Griffonia simplicifolia* IB4) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 647 in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 5 min)  
1.2 Fixation via intracardiac perfusion with 20 mL of 4% (wt/vol) paraformaldehyde (PFA) in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 10 min)  
1.3 Post-fixation of excised intact placenta in 4% PFA/PBS (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 4 hours)  

2 Immunostaining for Endothelial Structure  
2.1 Wash placenta 3× in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  
2.2 Block in blocking buffer (5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS) (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
2.3 Incubate with rat anti-mouse CD31 (PECAM1) primary antibody diluted 1:200 in blocking buffer (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 5 days with gentle agitation)  
2.4 Wash 5× in PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours per wash)  
2.5 Incubate with goat anti-rat IgG secondary antibody conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 diluted 1:400 in blocking buffer (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 3 days with gentle agitation)  
2.6 Wash 5× in PBST (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours per wash)  

3 Dehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.6 Repeat 100% methanol incubation (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Delipidation and Bleaching  
4.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared from 30% H₂O₂ stock) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)  
4.2 Wash 2× with 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min per wash)  

5 Rehydration (for optional post-clearing nuclear counterstain; skip if not needed)  
5.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)  
5.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)  
5.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)  
5.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)  
5.5 Incubation with PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 min)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Lectin (functional perfused lumen) + IB4 (complementary lectin for endothelial glycocalyx) + CD31/PECAM1 + Alexa Fluor 647 (structural endothelial confirmation)]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a high-clearing-power solvent-based method optimized for lipid- and pigment-rich tissues like placenta (T10_LIPID_OR_PIGMENT_RICH tier), enabling deep penetration of exogenous dyes and antibodies while preserving fluorescence of synthetic fluorophores. It is compatible with Lectin, IB4, and Alexa Fluor 647—critical for dual labeling of functional perfusion (Lectin/IB4 binding to luminal glycocalyx of patent vessels) and structural endothelium (CD31). Unlike iDISCO+, FDISCO better preserves signal intensity of lectin-based vascular labeling in dense microvascular networks, and its refractive index (~1.52) matches high-NA light-sheet objectives ideal for 3D vascular mapping. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are not used here, so quenching is irrelevant; instead, robust dye/antibody labeling is prioritized.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Perfusion-Mimetic Vascular Lumen Labeling (post-fixation)  
1.1 Incubation with 50 µg/mL *Lycopersicon esculentum* Lectin (Vector Labs, FL-1171) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 594 in PBS containing 1 mM CaCl₂ and 1 mM MnCl₂ (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with 10 µg/mL *Griffonia simplicifolia* Isolectin B4 (IB4, Thermo Fisher I21411) conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 in same buffer (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-PSD95 + Alexa Fluor 647, anti-MAP2 + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D visualization of excitatory postsynaptic structures (specifically PSD95-positive postsynaptic densities) and dendritic arbors (via MAP2) in 1–2 mm thick fixed mouse hippocampal CA1 tissue. FDISCO is an organic solvent-based clearing method established for dense brain tissue blocks of this thickness (T02_THICK_SLICE_0P5_3MM), offering strong delipidation power for deep antibody penetration and high transparency with minimal light scattering. Although FDISCO quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, it fully preserves signal from Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647 conjugates—ideal for dual-channel immunolabeling of PSD95 (a canonical excitatory postsynaptic scaffold protein) and MAP2 (a dendritic marker that delineates CA1 pyramidal neuron somata and apical dendrites). This combination enables precise quantification of synapse density, size, clustering, and spatial distribution along dendritic layers while preserving fine structural integrity of spines and puncta. FDISCO was selected over iDISCO+ due to its superior compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488 (iDISCO+ lists GFP/YFP as “avoid,” and while Alexa Fluor 488 is generally compatible, FDISCO provides broader fluorophore tolerance and reduced risk of signal loss for green-channel dyes in dense tissue).

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Rehydration (reverse methanol series after PFA fixation)  
1.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with 100% PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Permeabilization and Blocking  
2.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% donkey serum, 0.2% Triton X-100, 10% DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Primary Antibody Incubation  
3.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-PSD95 (1:200) and anti-MAP2 (1:500) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (3% donkey serum, 0.2% Tween-20, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, with gentle agitation)  

4 Washing  
4.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 day, with 6 buffer changes)  

5 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-mouse IgG Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit IgG Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) in antibody dilution buffer (3% donkey serum, 0.2% Tween-20, 0.1% sodium azide in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 days, protected from light)  

6 Post-immunostaining Washes  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 1 day, with 6 buffer changes, protected from light)  

7 Dehydration (methanol series)  
7.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 Delipidation  
8.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol). (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)  

9 Rehydration (reverse methanol series for dichloromethane equilibration)  
9.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with 100% water. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Dichloromethane (DCM) Treatment  
10.1 Incubation with 100% dichloromethane (DCM, anhydrous, ≥99.8%). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes, in fume hood)  
10.2 Incubation with fresh 100% dichloromethane. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes, in fume hood)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, in fume hood, protected from light)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE for long-term storage and imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour or until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-PSD95 + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-Homer1 + Alexa Fluor 568, anti-MAP2 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for high-resolution synaptic imaging in thick (0.5–3 mm) brain tissue blocks. It provides strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration while preserving fluorescence of Alexa Fluor dyes—critical for multiplexed detection of synaptic puncta. Unlike aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC, ScaleS), FDISCO achieves rapid, high-refractive-index matching with minimal light scattering, enabling high-resolution confocal or light-sheet imaging of dendritic spines. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched in solvent methods, so we use target-specific primary antibodies against two excitatory postsynaptic scaffold proteins (PSD95 and Homer1)—validated markers for functionally distinct excitatory synapses—and MAP2 to label CA1 dendritic arbors. All three Alexa Fluor conjugates (488, 568, 647) are fully compatible with FDISCO per compatibility data, ensuring bright, stable signals with low background. The protocol avoids nuclear counterstains (e.g., DAPI) and non-specific labels to prevent off-target signal and maintain structural fidelity.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS for permeabilization.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Primary Antibody Labeling  
2.1 Incubation with primary antibody cocktail: anti-PSD95 (1:200), anti-Homer1 (1:200), anti-MAP2 (1:500) in PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

3 Washing  
3.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (3 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  

4 Secondary Antibody Labeling  
4.1 Incubation with secondary antibody cocktail: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-mouse (1:500), Alexa Fluor 568 anti-rabbit (1:500), Alexa Fluor 647 anti-chicken (1:500) in PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

5 Post-labeling Wash  
5.1 Wash with PBS containing 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (3 changes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours total)  

6 Dehydration  
6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
6.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

7 Delipidation and Bleaching  
7.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared fresh from 30% H₂O₂ stock).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

8 Rehydration (for optional post-clearing immunostaining; skip if labeling complete)  
*(Skipped in this protocol as all labeling is completed pre-clearing)*  

9 Refractive Index Matching  
9.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in hexane.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

10 Storage and Imaging  
10.1 Transfer tissue to glass vial filled with fresh ethyl cinnamate (ECi) for long-term storage and imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-HCN4 + Alexa Fluor 647, anti-Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor 568, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based high-refractive-index clearing method established for dense mouse organs (T05 tier) with strong delipidation power, enabling deep antibody penetration into intact hearts while preserving fine structural morphology better than uDISCO/iDISCO+. It is compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes and does not quench synthetic fluorophores—critical since the user’s prior protocol suffered from weak signal and high background. HCN4 specifically labels sinoatrial/atrioventricular nodal pacemaker cells; Cntn2 robustly marks Purkinje fibers; Phalloidin-AF488 reveals F-actin in cardiomyocytes to retain fiber orientation without interfering with conduction system markers. This triple-labeling strategy avoids nuclear counterstains (e.g., DAPI), which contribute to myocardial background, and leverages FDISCO’s compatibility with all three Alexa Fluor conjugates for high signal-to-noise 3D imaging.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Immunolabeling (post-fixation, pre-clearing)  
1.1 Incubation with blocking/permeabilization buffer: 10% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 6 hours)  
1.2 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-HCN4 (1:200), anti-Cntn2 (1:300) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, gentle agitation)  
1.3 Wash with PBST (0.2% Tween-20 in PBS): 3 changes, 24 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 72 hours total)  
1.4 Incubation with secondary antibodies and Phalloidin: Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rabbit (1:400), Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated anti-mouse (1:400), Phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 488 (1:200) in blocking buffer. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 3 days, gentle agitation)  
1.5 Wash with PBST: 3 changes, 24 hours each. (Temperature: RT, Time: 72 hours total)  

2 Dehydration  
2.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
2.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
2.6 Repeat incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

3 Delipidation and Bleaching  
3.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)  
3.2 Wash with 100% (vol/vol) methanol: 2 changes. (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

4 Refractive Index Matching  
4.1 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in 100% methanol. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.3 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM (fresh). (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
4.4 Incubation with FDISCO mounting solution: 100% (vol/vol) ethyl cinnamate (ECi). (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.5 Final incubation in fresh 100% (vol/vol) ECi for imaging. (Temperature: RT, Time: ≥1 hour, store at RT in dark until imaging)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-PSD95 + Alexa Fluor 488, anti-Homer1 + Alexa Fluor 568, anti-MAP2 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-resolution 3D mapping of excitatory postsynaptic puncta (PSD95 and Homer1) along CA1 pyramidal neuron dendrites, necessitating deep antibody penetration into 1–2 mm thick fixed tissue and strong lipid clearing to reduce scattering. iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based method for dense brain slices (T02_THICK_SLICE_0P5_3MM tier), offering rapid, high-clearing power with excellent compatibility for Alexa Fluor dyes (488/568/647). Although it quenches endogenous FPs, our labeling relies on immunostaining—avoiding this limitation. PSD95 and Homer1 are target-specific markers for excitatory postsynaptic structures, and MAP2 is a well-validated dendritic marker that robustly labels CA1 pyramidal neuron dendrites without labeling spines directly, enabling accurate spatial registration of synaptic puncta while minimizing background misassignment as spines. All chosen fluorophores are explicitly compatible with iDISCO+, and the protocol includes stringent blocking and washing to suppress non-specific signal.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Preparation and Permeabilization  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Repeat 1.5 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional for autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Blocking and Primary Antibody Incubation  
4.1 Incubation with blocking solution (PBT + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with primary antibodies diluted in blocking solution: anti-PSD95 (1:200), anti-Homer1 (1:200), anti-MAP2 (1:500).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours, gentle shaking)  

5 Washing  
5.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.2 Repeat 5.1 five times, total 6 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

6 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
6.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies diluted in blocking solution: Alexa Fluor 488 anti-mouse (1:400), Alexa Fluor 568 anti-rabbit (1:400), Alexa Fluor 647 anti-chicken (1:400).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, gentle shaking, protected from light)  

7 Post-Labeling Washes  
7.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Repeat 7.1 five times, total 6 washes.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

8 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
8.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.6 Repeat 8.5 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

9 Delipidation  
9.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Repeat 9.1 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

10 Refractive Index Matching  
10.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  
10.2 Replace with fresh 100% DBE for long-term storage or immediate imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: ≥30 minutes before imaging)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [anti-HCN4 + Alexa Fluor 647, anti-Cntn2 + Alexa Fluor 568, Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method established for dense, lipid-rich mouse organs (5–20 mm) like the heart, offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration—critical for visualizing the entire conduction system within intact myocardium. It preserves morphology with minimal distortion compared to other solvent methods and is fully compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes and phalloidin. HCN4 is a well-validated marker for sinoatrial and atrioventricular nodal pacemaker cells; Cntn2 (Contactin-2) specifically labels Purkinje fibers in the ventricles. Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 binds F-actin to reveal cardiomyocyte orientation as an anatomical reference. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are avoided due to organic solvents; instead, robust Alexa Fluor-conjugated secondary detection ensures signal stability through dehydration and clearing. FDISCO was selected over iDISCO+ due to its superior compatibility with all chosen fluorophores (including Alexa Fluor 488), which iDISCO+ does not support reliably.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Hu C/D + Alexa Fluor 488, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method optimized for large, dense tissues like the intact mouse colon (6–8 cm), offering strong delipidation and high refractive index matching while preserving exogenous fluorophores such as Alexa Fluor dyes. It supports deep antibody penetration required for whole-mount immunolabeling of thick tubular organs and minimizes fluorescence quenching compared to iDISCO+. Hu C/D and PGP9.5 are well-established pan-neuronal markers for the enteric nervous system (ENS), enabling robust detection of both neuronal somata (ganglia) and axonal processes. Phalloidin labels F-actin in smooth muscle layers, providing structural context to distinguish myenteric (between muscle layers) from submucosal plexuses. All chosen fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 488/568/647) are fully compatible with FDISCO per compatibility data.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Rehydration (if stored in methanol)  
1.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBST) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

2 Permeabilization and Blocking  
2.1 Incubation with PBST + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.5% (wt/vol) sodium azide (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Primary Antibody Staining  
3.1 Incubation with anti-Hu C/D (mouse monoclonal, 1:500) and anti-PGP9.5 (rabbit polyclonal, 1:400) in PBST + 5% donkey serum + 0.5% sodium azide (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

4 Washing  
4.1 Incubation with PBST (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, with 6 buffer changes every 4 hours)  

5 Secondary Antibody + Phalloidin Staining  
5.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500), Alexa Fluor 647-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500), and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated Phalloidin (1:200) in PBST + 5% donkey serum + 0.5% sodium azide (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 5 days, protected from light, gentle agitation)  

6 Post-Staining Washes  
6.1 Incubation with PBST (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours, with 6 buffer changes every 4 hours, protected from light)  

7 Dehydration  
7.1 Incubation with 30% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.4 Incubation with 90% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.5 Incubation with 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
7.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

8 Delipidation and Bleaching (optional, if pigmentation present)  
8.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol (prepared fresh: 1 vol 30% H₂O₂ + 5 vol MeOH) (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours, protected from light)  

9 Re-dehydration (post-bleach)  
9.1 Incubation with 100% methanol (Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Refractive Index Matching  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and ethyl cinnamate (ECi) (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi, RI ≈ 1.558) (Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours, protected from light)  

11 Sample Storage and Imaging Preparation  
11.1 Transfer cleared colon into glass vial filled with fresh ethyl cinnamate and store at RT in the dark until imaging (stable for ≥2 weeks). Mount vertically or coiled in a custom imaging chamber filled with ECi for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568, CD31 (PECAM1)+Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based high-refractive-index clearing method established for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration while preserving Alexa Fluor dye signals—critical for resolving fine slit diaphragm structures. It avoids quenching of synthetic fluorophores (unlike iDISCO+) and provides superior transparency across lipid-rich renal cortex and medulla. Dual labeling of Nephrin and Podocin—core slit diaphragm components—enables assessment of filtration barrier continuity, while CD31 labels glomerular endothelia to contextualize capillary architecture without substituting for podocyte-specific markers.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional, if endogenous pigment present)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Primary Antibody Staining  
3.1 Rehydration: sequential incubation in 80%, 60%, 40%, 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS, 30 min each.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes per step)  
3.2 Permeabilization and blocking: incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
3.3 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-Nephrin (1:200), anti-Podocin (1:200), anti-CD31 (1:100) in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours with gentle agitation)  

4 Wash  
4.1 Wash with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 6 changes over 48 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours per wash)  

5 Secondary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with species-specific secondary antibodies: Alexa Fluor 488 (anti-rabbit, 1:400), Alexa Fluor 568 (anti-goat, 1:400), Alexa Fluor 647 (anti-rat, 1:400) in PBS + 0.2% Triton X-100 + 5% serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours with gentle agitation)  

6 Post-staining Wash  
6.1 Wash with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 6 changes over 48 hours.(Temperature: RT, Time: 8 hours per wash)  

7 Dehydration (post-immunostaining)  
7.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
7.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

8 Delipidation  
8.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

9 Refractive Index Matching  
9.1 Incubation with ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma-Aldrich 112372) without shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
9.2 Incubation with fresh ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

10 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
10.1 Store sample immersed in ethyl cinnamate (ECi) at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
10.2 Mount in glass-bottom dish filled with ECi for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate imaging)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Hu C/D + Alexa Fluor 488, β-III Tubulin (TUJ1) + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based clearing method established for long tubular tissues (T06 tier) with high lipid content like the colon. It enables deep antibody penetration, strong delipidation to reduce muscle autofluorescence, and effective refractive index matching for whole-mount imaging. Unlike iDISCO+, FDISCO maintains compatibility with Alexa Fluor 488 and Alexa Fluor 647 without risk of signal quenching, as confirmed by method–fluorophore compatibility data. Endogenous fluorescent proteins are quenched during processing, so we use robust secondary antibodies conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (for neuronal soma via Hu C/D) and Alexa Fluor 647 (for pan-neuronal fibers via TUJ1), both fully compatible with FDISCO. This dual-labeling strategy specifically resolves myenteric (between muscle layers) and submucosal (beneath mucosa) plexuses while preserving layered architecture. Methanol dehydration and DCM/DBE steps effectively suppress background from smooth muscle, addressing the user’s key issue of high muscle signal masking ENS structures.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for colon autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Incubation  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Hu C/D (1:500) and anti-β-III Tubulin (TUJ1, 1:500) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
6.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Incubation  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) donkey serum + 0.2% (wt/vol) sodium azide.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle agitation, protected from light)  

8 Post-Labeling Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
8.3 Incubation with PBT.(Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample in sealed glass vial filled with DBE at RT, protected from light, until imaging by light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [HuC/D + Alexa Fluor 568, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 488]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is a solvent-based clearing method with high delipidation power and deep antibody penetration, making it ideal for dense, lipid-rich, and long tubular tissues like the intact mouse colon (6–8 cm). It effectively clears thick samples while preserving 3D architecture of layered gut wall structures. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling strategy uses robust, covalently conjugated Alexa Fluor dyes compatible with iDISCO+. HuC/D and PGP9.5 are well-established pan-neuronal markers for ENS that label both neuronal somata and fibers in myenteric and submucosal plexuses; dual labeling enhances signal reliability. Phalloidin-Alexa Fluor 488 specifically labels F-actin in smooth muscle layers (circular and longitudinal) and epithelial actin belts, enabling precise registration of ENS networks relative to mucosal, submucosal, and muscular layers. All chosen fluorophores (Alexa Fluor 488/568/647) are explicitly compatible with iDISCO+ per compatibility data.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for colon autofluorescence reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with permeabilization solution (0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking solution (6% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibodies: anti-HuC/D (1:200), anti-PGP9.5 (1:200), and Phalloidin (1:100) diluted in antibody dilution buffer (3% (vol/vol) donkey serum, 10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, gentle shaking)  

6 Washes after Primary Staining  
6.1 Incubation with wash buffer (10% (vol/vol) DMSO, 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.3 Repeat wash buffer incubation.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining (if needed; note: Phalloidin is directly conjugated)  
7.1 Incubation with secondary antibodies: donkey anti-mouse IgG-Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) and donkey anti-rabbit IgG-Alexa Fluor 647 (1:500) in antibody dilution buffer. *Note: If HuC/D and PGP9.5 are from same host species, use directly conjugated primaries or sequential staining.* Alternatively, use directly conjugated primary antibodies to avoid secondaries. For this protocol, assume HuC/D and PGP9.5 are directly conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 and 647 respectively, so skip this step.  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with wash buffer (10% DMSO, 0.2% Triton X-100, 0.3 M glycine in PBS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Incubation with 0.2% (vol/vol) Tween-20 in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.3 Incubation with 100% PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

9 Dehydration (pre-clearing)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, protected from light.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Store sample immersed in DBE at RT in amber glass vial, sealed with parafilm.(Temperature: RT, Time: until imaging)  
12.2 Mount sample in DBE-filled imaging chamber compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy, ensuring minimal air bubbles and proper orientation along the longitudinal axis.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** iDISCO+ is an established solvent-based clearing method for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering strong delipidation and deep antibody penetration required for intact kidney (~10–12 mm). It preserves fine subcellular structures like slit diaphragms with minimal epitope damage when combined with robust primary antibodies. Alexa Fluor 488 and 568 are explicitly compatible with iDISCO+, providing bright, photostable signals for high-resolution 3D imaging of Nephrin and Podocin—two target-specific markers essential for identifying slit diaphragm integrity. Endogenous fluorescence is quenched in iDISCO+, so direct immunolabeling with these dyes is necessary and optimal. Nuclear counterstains or lectins are avoided per constraints, as they do not label slit diaphragm identity.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for fixed kidney to reduce autofluorescence)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBT + 20% (vol/vol) DMSO + 0.3 M glycine.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with PBT + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO + 6% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Nephrin (NPHS1) rabbit monoclonal antibody (1:200) and anti-Podocin (NPHS2) goat polyclonal antibody (1:200) diluted in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

6 Wash  
6.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
6.2 Repeat wash step 6.1 two more times, changing solution every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with donkey anti-rabbit IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 488 (1:500) and donkey anti-goat IgG conjugated to Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) in PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO + 3% (wt/vol) donkey serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 7 days, with gentle agitation)  

8 Wash  
8.1 Incubation with PBT + 5% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
8.2 Repeat wash step 8.1 two more times, changing solution every 24 hours.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours each)  

9 Dehydration (post-staining)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation

10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching

11.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DBE in glass vial, sealed to prevent evaporation.(Temperature: RT, Time: 24 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation

12.2 Mount sample in a glass-bottom imaging chamber filled with DBE for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: immediate use)

1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Nephrin (NPHS1)+Alexa Fluor 488, Podocin (NPHS2)+Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based, high-refractive-index clearing method established for dense mouse soft organs (5–20 mm), offering strong delipidation power to overcome the lipid-rich and structurally heterogeneous cortex/medulla of the kidney. It preserves Alexa Fluor dyes effectively and enables deep antibody penetration—critical for labeling intracellular slit diaphragm proteins Nephrin and Podocin throughout the entire organ. Unlike aqueous methods (e.g., CUBIC), FDISCO achieves uniform transparency in both cortical and medullary regions without residual opacity or high background. Endogenous fluorescence is not relied upon; instead, target-specific primary antibodies against Nephrin and Podocin are paired with compatible Alexa Fluor conjugates, ensuring specific, low-background dual-labeling of the glomerular filtration barrier for 3D quantification.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for pigment-rich kidneys)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in 100% methanol.(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum (NGS).(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 6 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Nephrin (NPHS1) rabbit polyclonal antibody (1:200) and anti-Podocin (NPHS2) guinea pig polyclonal antibody (1:200) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NGS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 five times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

7 Secondary Antibody Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488-conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:500) and Alexa Fluor 568-conjugated anti-guinea pig IgG (1:500) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) NGS.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 five times, changing solution every hour.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour per wash)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) : methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with ethyl cinnamate (ECi, Sigma E10021) without shaking.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to fresh ECi in glass vial, seal, and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** EyeCi  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]  
**Justification:** EyeCi is specifically established for whole-eye and retinal tissue (T12_WHOLE_EYE_OR_RETINA tier), excels at preserving delicate laminar architecture of the retina with minimal shrinkage or distortion, and is compatible with lipophilic carbocyanine dyes like DiI and DiD—critical for retaining anterograde/retrograde tracing signals across the retinal–LGN–V1 pathway. Unlike organic solvent–based methods (e.g., iDISCO+), EyeCi avoids harsh dehydration and delipidation steps that extract or quench lipid-anchored dyes and cause retinal wrinkling. Its aqueous formulation maintains tissue hydration and geometry while achieving sufficient clearing in small neural tissues (retina, LGN, V1). DiI (Ex/Em ~549/565 nm) and DiD (Ex/Em ~644/665 nm) provide spectrally separable, stable membrane labeling ideal for dual-branch projection mapping without requiring additional immunostaining or exogenous fluorophores beyond the problem constraints.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Tissue Preparation and Pre-Clearing Equilibration  
1.1 Incubation with 0.1 M phosphate buffer (PB), pH 7.4, to rinse residual fixative. (Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
1.2 Incubation with EyeCi-P1 solution (25% (wt/vol) fructose, 10% (wt/vol) α-thioglycerol, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PB). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

2 Optical Clearing  
2.1 Incubation with fresh EyeCi-P1 solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.2 Incubation with EyeCi-P2 solution (40% (wt/vol) fructose, 15% (wt/vol) α-thioglycerol, 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 in PB). (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
2.3 Incubation with fresh EyeCi-P2 solution. (Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  

3 Refractive Index Matching  
3.1 Incubation with EyeCi-M solution (63% (wt/vol) fructose, 20% (wt/vol) α-thioglycerol in PB, RI ≈ 1.45). (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  
3.2 Incubation with fresh EyeCi-M solution. (Temperature: RT, Time: 12 hours)  

4 Final Mounting and Imaging Preparation  
4.1 Transfer samples into glass-bottom imaging dishes or capillary tubes filled with EyeCi-M solution.  
4.2 Seal samples to prevent evaporation and store at 4 ℃ in the dark until imaging. (Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: up to 1 week)

DiI and DiD are spectrally separable (ex/em ~549/565 nm and ~644/665 nm, respectively), photostable, and compatible with organic solvent–based clearing. iDISCO+ provides strong delipidation and high transparency for dense, lipid-rich tissues like retina, LGN, and V1, while preserving DiI/DiD fluorescence. Endogenous FPs are not used per problem constraints, so FP quenching by iDISCO+ is irrelevant. TO-PRO-3 was removed because nuclear counterstains (including TO-PRO-3) are explicitly excluded as target-specific labeling per the knowledge base; structural registration must rely on the projection-specific tracers themselves or additional target-specific immunostaining, but the current labeling set already satisfies both required targets: DiI/DiD label the retinal-LGN-V1 projection pathway directly and also resolve retinal lamination due to their membrane integration in neuronal processes. iDISCO+ also enables rapid, deep clearing of millimeter-scale samples with established protocols for visual pathway mapping.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration

2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

5.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
5.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

8 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Transfer cleared samples to glass vials filled with fresh DBE and store at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite for short-term; image within 1 week for optimal DiI/DiD signal)

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires tracing two distinct retinal ganglion cell (RGC) projection branches from retina through LGN to V1 using lipophilic carbocyanine dyes DiI and DiD, which are well-established for long-range axonal tracing and compatible with solvent-based clearing. iDISCO+ is selected because it provides strong delipidation and high clearing power essential for dense, lipid-rich neural tissues (retina, LGN, V1), supports deep penetration and retention of DiI/DiD fluorescence, and enables whole-mount 3D imaging of intact visual pathway segments. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies solely on exogenous DiI/DiD. Among established methods for T12_WHOLE_EYE_OR_RETINA tier, iDISCO+ offers faster processing and superior transparency for mm-scale samples compared to aqueous alternatives, while preserving sufficient morphology for circuit mapping.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Delipidation  
2.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
2.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

3 Rehydration (for DiI/DiD pre-labeling compatibility; skip if dyes applied post-fixation but before dehydration—assumed already labeled per problem statement)  
3.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.6 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Primary Antibody Incubation (skipped – no antibody used; DiI/DiD are direct tracers)  

5 Secondary Antibody Incubation (skipped – no antibody used)  

6 Dehydration (post-labeling, if not already dehydrated)  
6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

7 Bleaching (optional for pigment-rich retina; include to enhance transparency)  
7.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

8 Delipidation (final)  
8.1 Incubation with 66% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM) in methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
8.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dichloromethane (DCM).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

9 Refractive Index Matching  
9.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  
9.2 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

10 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
10.1 Transfer samples to glass vials filled with fresh 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE) for long-term storage at RT in the dark.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)  
10.2 Mount cleared samples in DBE-filled imaging chambers compatible with light-sheet or confocal microscopy for 3D acquisition of DiI (Ex/Em ~549/565 nm) and DiD (Ex/Em ~644/665 nm) signals.

**Chosen Method:** iDISCO+  
**Chosen Labeling:** [DiI, DiD]  
**Justification:** The scientific goal requires high-fidelity 3D mapping of DiI/DiD-labeled visual projection fibers across the retina–LGN–V1 axis while preserving retinal lamination. iDISCO+ is selected because it provides strong delipidation and clearing power for lipid- and pigment-rich tissues like the intact retina and brain regions (LGN/V1), supports deep penetration and retention of lipophilic carbocyanine dyes (DiI/DiD), and enables rapid whole-tissue clearing suitable for large samples. Although iDISCO+ quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, this is irrelevant here as labeling relies on exogenous DiI/DiD. TO-PRO-3 was removed because nuclear counterstains (including TO-PRO-3) are not target-specific markers for either the retinal-LGN-V1 projection pathway or retinal lamination; structural delineation must rely on target-specific labeling (e.g., RBPMS, Brn3a) or morphology alone. DiI and DiD are validated as compatible with iDISCO+ and serve as direct tracers of neuronal projections, fulfilling the requirement for target-specific labeling of the visual pathway.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (prepared by mixing 1 volume 30% H₂O₂ with 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)

3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (PBT).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

5.2 Incubation with 50% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.3 Incubation with 70% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.4 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
5.5 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

6.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)

7.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 488, anti-Myosin VIIa–Alexa Fluor 568]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based, high-clearing-power method established for hard tissues like bone and cochlea (T07_HARD_TISSUE_BONE_TOOTH_COCHLEA), enabling deep penetration of dyes/antibodies into mineralized cochlear shells while preserving 3D spiral morphology with minimal distortion. It is compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes, and although it quenches endogenous FPs, our labeling relies on exogenous probes. Phalloidin directly labels F-actin in stereocilia bundles; Myosin VIIa is a well-validated, specific marker for both inner and outer hair cells. TO-PRO-3 was removed because nuclear counterstains (including TO-PRO-3) are not target-specific and are explicitly cautioned against for Myosin VIIa per compatibility guidelines. This combination allows precise 3D mapping of hair cell identity, spatial distribution, and stereocilia integrity across cochlear turns.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Delipidation and Bleaching  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 10% (vol/vol) DMSO.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 2 hours)  
4.2 Incubation with blocking buffer: PBS + 5% (vol/vol) normal donkey serum + 0.5% (wt/vol) BSA + 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Immunolabeling and Phalloidin Staining  
5.1 Incubation with primary antibody: rabbit anti-Myosin VIIa (1:200) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  
5.2 Wash with PBS + 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (3 changes, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  
5.3 Incubation with secondary antibody: donkey anti-rabbit Alexa Fluor 568 (1:500) + Phalloidin–Alexa Fluor 488 (1:100) in blocking buffer.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 24 hours)  
5.4 Wash with PBS + 0.3% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 (3 changes, 1 hour each).(Temperature: RT, Time: 3 hours total)  

6 Dehydration (post-staining)  
6.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
6.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

7 Clearing and Refractive Index Matching  
7.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and ethyl cinnamate (ECi).(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
7.2 Incubation with 100% ethyl cinnamate (ECi, RI ≈ 1.557).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

8 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
8.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh 100% ethyl cinnamate.(Temperature: RT, Time: Indefinite storage)  
8.2 Mount in imaging chamber filled with ethyl cinnamate for light-sheet or confocal microscopy.(Temperature: RT, Time: Immediate imaging)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Myosin VIIa + Alexa Fluor 488, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 568, PGP9.5 + Alexa Fluor 647]  
**Justification:** The sample is a mineralized, dense hard tissue (intact mouse cochlea with bone), requiring a high-clearing-power method that enables deep antibody and dye penetration while preserving fine 3D morphology of hair cells, stereocilia bundles, and neural processes. FDISCO—a solvent-based, fluorescence-preserving variant of DISCO—is established for hard tissues like cochlea and bone, provides strong delipidation and refractive index homogenization, and is compatible with Alexa Fluor dyes. Myosin VIIa specifically labels cochlear hair cells, Phalloidin robustly stains F-actin–rich stereocilia bundles, and PGP9.5 (a pan-neuronal marker) reliably visualizes cochlear nerve fibers, including their terminal arborizations around hair cells. All three targets are labeled via immunostaining or direct conjugation with Alexa Fluor dyes, which are fully compatible with FDISCO.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Bleaching (optional but recommended for endogenous pigment reduction)  
2.1 Incubation with chilled 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ + 5 volumes methanol).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS containing 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 and 10% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining  
5.1 Incubation with anti-Myosin VIIa (1:200) and anti-PGP9.5 (1:400) diluted in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 72 hours)  

6 Washing  
6.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
6.2 Repeat step 6.1 two more times (total 3 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

7 Secondary Antibody and Phalloidin Staining  
7.1 Incubation with Alexa Fluor 488–conjugated anti-rabbit IgG (1:400), Alexa Fluor 647–conjugated anti-mouse IgG (1:400), and Alexa Fluor 568–conjugated Phalloidin (1:100) in PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: 37 ℃, Time: 48 hours)  

8 Post-staining Washes  
8.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.2% (vol/vol) Triton X-100.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
8.2 Repeat step 8.1 two more times (total 3 washes).(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour each)  

9 Dehydration (post-labeling)  
9.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
9.5 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
9.6 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

10 Delipidation  
10.1 Incubation with 1:2 (vol/vol) mixture of dichloromethane (DCM) and methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Repeat step 10.2 once.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

11 Refractive Index Matching  
11.1 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) dibenzyl ether (DBE, Sigma 108014-1KG).(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

12 Storage and Imaging Preparation  
12.1 Transfer sample to glass vial filled with fresh DBE and store at RT in the dark until imaging.(Temperature: RT, Time: indefinite)

**Chosen Method:** FDISCO  
**Chosen Labeling:** [Myosin VIIa + Alexa Fluor 647, Phalloidin + Alexa Fluor 568, β-III Tubulin + Alexa Fluor 488 (optional for neural analysis)]  
**Justification:** FDISCO is a solvent-based, high-clearing-power method specifically validated for dense, mineralized tissues like the intact mouse cochlea (T07_HARD_TISSUE_BONE_TOOTH_COCHLEA). It enables deep penetration of antibodies and dyes into bone-encased structures while achieving strong transparency without requiring decalcification. Although it quenches endogenous fluorescent proteins, our labeling strategy uses exogenous, covalently conjugated Alexa Fluor dyes—compatible with FDISCO—which provide bright, photostable signals for Myosin VIIa (specific hair cell marker), Phalloidin (F-actin in stereocilia bundles), and optionally β-III Tubulin (for nerve fiber visualization). This combination ensures high signal-to-noise, minimal background, and preservation of 3D architecture across all cochlear turns.

**Protocol Steps:**  
1 Dehydration  
1.1 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.2 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.3 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.5 Incubation with 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  
1.6 Incubation with fresh 100% methanol.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)  

2 Delipidation and Bleaching  
2.1 Incubation with chilled fresh 5% (vol/vol) H₂O₂ in methanol (1 volume 30% H₂O₂ to 5 volumes MeOH).(Temperature: 4 ℃, Time: 12 hours)  

3 Rehydration (for immunolabeling)  
3.1 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.2 Incubation with 60% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.3 Incubation with 40% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.4 Incubation with 20% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
3.5 Incubation with PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  

4 Permeabilization and Blocking  
4.1 Incubation with PBS + 0.5% (vol/vol) Triton X-100 + 5% (vol/vol) normal goat serum.(Temperature: RT, Time: 2 hours)  

5 Primary Antibody Staining (Hair Cell Identity & Neural Marker)

9.4 Incubation with 80% (vol/vol) methanol in PBS.(Temperature: RT, Time: 1 hour)

10.2 Incubation with 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)  
10.3 Incubation with fresh 100% (vol/vol) DCM.(Temperature: RT, Time: 30 minutes)
